fieldValues.title: D1 Structured semantic document
fieldValues.summary: A document is authored as typed Records in a Container, with explicit fields and relations instead of an opaque page blob.
fieldValues.body:
## Group Need

We need to write a guide, policy, specification or handbook without separating its content from the structure that makes it understandable.

## Semantic Adds

- document root Record
- typed content Records
- Container membership and ordering relations

## Blueprint Adds

- basic document form
- generic record navigation

## Does Not Introduce

- a website-specific page schema
- a required bespoke renderer
- shared reusable definition packages

## Activation Trigger

A group needs a document whose structure and meaning must remain inspectable as it is written.

## Research

- problem-index/07-field-records/README.md: Content is maintained meaning: fields need an inspectable change history, not a monolithic document blob.
